name: The Knack
hook: The Los Angeles band whose 'My Sharona' was the number-one song of 1979, and whose singer helped Weird Al get his first record deal.
blurb: The Knack formed in Los Angeles in 1978: Doug Fieger, Berton Averre, Prescott Niles and Bruce Gary. Capitol Records paid more to sign them than it had ever paid any band. Their first single, 'My Sharona', was number one in America for five weeks and was the biggest song of 1979. But the marketing, an album cover that looked so much like the Beatles' 'Meet the Beatles!' that critics called them copycats, and what people took the songs to be about set off a fast backlash, with the slogan 'Knuke the Knack'. They split in 1982, reformed in 1986, 1994 and 1996, and ended for good when Fieger died in February 2010. By Yankovic's account, Fieger told a Capitol executive backstage at Cal Poly that the label should release 'My Bologna'.
